'''Ryszard Horodecki''' (born 30 September 1943) is a Polish [[physicist]] and a professor of [[University of Gdańsk]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ug.edu.pl/pracownik/1070/ryszard_horodecki|title=University of Gdańsk website|publisher=|accessdate=24 November 2014}}</ref> He contributed largely to the field of [[quantum informatics]]. In his most widely cited paper, 'Separability of Mixed States: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions'<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Horodecki|first1=Michał|last2=Horodecki|first2=Paweł|last3=Horodecki|first3=Ryszard|date=1996|title=Separability of mixed states: necessary and sufficient conditions|url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0375960196007062|journal=Physics Letters A|language=en|volume=223|issue=1–2|pages=1–8|doi=10.1016/S0375-9601(96)00706-2|arxiv=quant-ph/9605038|bibcode=1996PhLA..223....1H |s2cid=10580997 }}</ref> written together with his sons, [[Michał Horodecki|Michał]] and [[Paweł Horodecki|Paweł]], he proposed the idea currently known as the [[Peres–Horodecki criterion]]. With over 12,000 citations, he is considered to be one of the leading Polish physicists.{{Citation needed|date=June 2014}}

==Career==

He graduated from Department of Electronics, University of Gdańsk. Horodecki received his Ph.D. from [[Gdańsk University of Technology]] in 1976. Twenty-one years later, in 1997 he obtained his [[habilitation]] from [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]] in [[Toruń]]. His contribution to the quantum informatics were acknowledged in 2008, when he received the [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] in the field of [[mathematics]] and [[physics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fnp.org.pl/prof-ryszard-horodecki-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2008/|title=Ryszard Horodecki - Foundation for Polish Science website|work=Fundacja na rzecz Nauki Polskiej|accessdate=24 November 2014}}</ref> In 2010 he became a member of [[Polish Academy of Sciences]], whereas in 2011 received prestigious [[European Research Council|ERC Advanced Grant]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fnp.org.pl/prof-horodecki-laureatem-grantu-erc/|title=Horodecki to receive ERC grant|work=Fundacja na rzecz Nauki Polskiej|date=11 January 2012 |accessdate=24 November 2014}}</ref>

Beyond scientific work, Horodecki publishes also poems in several Polish newspapers, particularly in [[Tygodnik Powszechny]].

==Personal life==

Horodecki's sons, [[Michał Horodecki|Michał]], [[Paweł Horodecki|Paweł]], and [[Karol Horodecki|Karol]] are also physicists working in Gdańsk with all of whom he jointly published the review article "Quantum entanglement".<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Horodecki|first1=Ryszard|last2=Horodecki|first2=Paweł|last3=Horodecki|first3=Michał|last4=Horodecki|first4=Karol|date=2009|title=Quantum entanglement|url=https://journals.aps.org/rmp/abstract/10.1103/RevModPhys.81.865|journal=Reviews of Modern Physics|language=en|volume=81|issue=2 |pages=865–942|doi=10.1103/RevModPhys.81.865|arxiv=quant-ph/0702225 |bibcode=2009RvMP...81..865H |s2cid=59577352 }}</ref>
